title: SD: Number of data points (n)
summary: Total number of observations. With FreqOn this is the sum of frequencies, not the number of distinct x-values.

body.text: n is the sample size. Each DT with frequency 1 adds 1. With FreqOn, entering x ; f DT adds f to n. Line = on the editor is the number of stored records (pairs or points), which can be smaller than n when frequencies are greater than 1.

body.plain:
n = \sum f_i
\text{FreqOff: each point has } f_i = 1

items: MODE 4. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 → 1 (Stat) → EXE to clear the old list
body.title: On the calculator

items: Confirm FreqOn in SETUP, then MODE 4
body.title: On the calculator

body.text: The calculator keeps n as it builds the list. [[modes/sd/mean]] and [[modes/sd/stdev]] are then worked out from n, Σx, and Σx². Sample standard deviation (sx) needs at least two data points.
